name: Tech Titan Clash
description: A premium-brand rival with twice your capital is flooding the high-income aisles with flagship televisions and cars, priced well above the market. Out-engineer them in the Eastside car market, out-sell them on Metropolis televisions, and still be standing — and worth more — when the five years are up.

goals.description: Sell 30% of the cars bought in Eastside (trailing three months) — the rival's first stronghold.
Sell 25% of the televisions bought in Metropolis — deny the titan a clean sweep of the densest market.
Be worth at least $125M when the scenario ends in December 2030 — survive the spending war and come out ahead.
